title: From Montreal Quebec City Montmorency Falls Tour and Free Pickup
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Infants are required to sit on an adult’s lap
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Discover Quebec City on a full-day private trip from Montreal with hotel pick-up, guided by a trusted local expert in curated private tours. This tour is available in English, French, Spanish, or Portuguese.
Travel in comfort in a private vehicle with a guide, enjoying scenic landscapes along the way and engaging commentary on the region's history and culture.
Explore Old Quebec, a UNESCO World Heritage Site, with its cobblestone streets, charming boutiques, and European atmosphere. Admire the iconic Château Frontenac and immerse yourself in one of North America's oldest cities.
Experience the city's rich French heritage through its cuisine, local shops, and vibrant cultural scene.
Continue to Montmorency Falls, a spectacular natural site even taller than Niagara Falls, offering breathtaking views and photo opportunities.
This private tour offers a comfortable, flexible, and enriching way to discover Quebec City's top highlights, with multilingual guiding to suit your group.
